title: Selective removal of Ca2+ from brackish water by electrodialysis desalination: process optimization and application
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00885E, Paper

Based on the analysis of ion migration by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, a guided electrodialysis integrated device was designed to desalinate brackish water and improve drinking water safety.
